question: In which of the following dances the basic dance formation is that of a circle that moves counter-clockwise, where dancers form concentric circles that move in opposite directions?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Garba.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Garba is a traditional folk dance from Gujarat, India, also performed during Navratri.
 
• Dancers move in a circle, tapping their feet and clapping their hands to the music.
 
• The circle may move counterclockwise or clockwise, depending on the region and tradition.
 
• The word "garba" is derived from the Sanskrit word "garbha," which means "womb" or "embryo." This is because the dance is believed to represent the cycle of life and death.
 
• Dancers wear colorful traditional clothing, including ghagras (long skirts) for women and chaniya-choli (kurta and skirt) for men.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tamasha​

 
 
• Tamasha is a traditional folk dance of Maharashtra, India.
 
• It is a satirical dance, often used to poke fun at social and political issues.
 
• The dance is typically performed by men.
 
• Dancers wear colorful traditional clothing, including dhotis (sarungs) and turbans.
 
• The music for Tamasha is typically played on dhol (drum), harmonium, and tabla (pair of drums).
 
 
 
• Ras Lila​
 
 
• Ras Lila is a traditional dance-drama of India, based on the Hindu legend of Radha and Krishna.
 
• It is a devotional dance, performed to express love for the divine.
 
• The dance is typically performed during the Hindu festival of Holi.
 
• Dancers wear colorful traditional clothing, including sarees for women and dhotis for men.
 
• The music for Ras Lila is typically played on flute, harmonium, and tabla (pair of drums).
 
 
 
• Suggi​
 
 
• Suggi is a folk dance of North India, particularly in the states of Punjab, Haryana, and Himachal Pradesh.
 
• It is a lively and energetic dance, typically performed by women during the harvest season.
 
• The dance is characterized by its fast movements and intricate footwork.
 
• Dancers wear colorful traditional clothing, including ghagras (long skirts) and dupattas (scarves).
 
• The music for Suggi is typically played on dhol (drum), tumbi (jug), and harmonium.
